description_en: We are selling a 2+1+2 apartment in the heart of Tirana. Buy your apartment in a unique project along New Boulevard. Just a few minutes away from the Center, in an area with strategic development. The apartment is located on the 8th floor of a 25-story building. Net area: 102.2m2 Gross area: 128.8m2 Organized: Living room together with kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 2 balconies. Orientation: South-East The project is currently in the construction phase and the carabiner of the -3rd floor is under construction. What makes this project unique? • 14 modern elevators. • Technical stability with high construction standards. • Elastic waterproofing PVC membrane, which ensures longevity and optimal protection. • Advanced system against fire and certified emergency ladder, for maximum safety. • Ventilated facade and acoustic insulation, for comfort and energy efficiency • Ecological materials and solar panels, for a sustainable construction. For more information, contact me!
